production.caller: Scene::get; Scene::apply_one, Insert and all update arms

specification: For any tree and any identity: both lookups miss exactly when neither the node nor any descendant has the identity. A read hit returns the first preorder match. A mutable hit lends that same node, and the tree when the loan ends is the old tree with exactly that node replaced by what the loan left there; every node on the path keeps its other fields and child count, and every other child is unchanged. A mutable miss leaves the tree unchanged. Terminates by the Vec element decrease axiom.

Verus+Z3.model_note: NodeKind, Style, Semantics and Point are replaced in the proof by value types the kernel cannot read; derives are removed from Node in the proof copy because recursive Clone through Vec is a cycle in Verus. Rustc compiles the same kernel tokens against the real types. The final state of the tree is stated through Verus prophecy on the returned reference.

Proptest.includes: Arbitrary trees up to 24 nodes against an independent explicit-stack preorder walk, with both lookups compared by address and a write through the loan compared to the same write on the oracle's path; small shapes against a clone-free reader

Loom.reason: The kernel holds no shared state and no synchronization primitive; the mutable lookup takes the tree by &mut, so the compiler excludes concurrent access.
Loom.substitute_evidence: None added: the compiler's exclusive-borrow rule is the argument. It is not a concurrency proof.

real_path_test.mutation_checked: Four manual mutations, one run each, not in the Verus control table: inverted holder test, read path always asking child 0, mutable path always descending child 0, and inverted identity match each failed the new unit test. Asking child 0 and descending child 0 were caught only by the new test among the scene unit tests.

behavior_change_note: find_node's iterator closure became an indexed loop and the comparison id.0. find_node_mut now asks the read path which child holds the identity before descending, because a mutable borrow returned from a loop cannot be retried after a miss and Verus has no usable specification for iter_mut. The result is meant to be unchanged; that equivalence with the old text is argued by reading and tests, not proved. The worst-case cost rises from proportional to node count to node count times depth; the actual effect was not measured.
